notes.title: Vaultbreakers: Weekly content update [September 12th 2025]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



This is where you can find our weekly updates in case you missed our posts on Discord and on X. Here is a summary of what was discussed in the past few weeks. 🌿



🗓️Next Playtest:
Our upcoming playtest, which was originally scheduled for the end of October, has been rescheduled for NOVEMBER 13th. This gives us more time to polish the new content we want to add and to ensure a smoother experience.  

P.S. Trios will be introduced in this playtest! 🔥



🧍Updated NPC models:


Silverhook Sam:

You might remember an NPC named Silverhook Sam from our last playtest, and well... he was kind of given a glow-up. Meet the updated version of Sam, a swashbuckling pirate with his trusty parrot. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/0248f652a2648d3f2388a5f7dc868f5470fd1ae7.png"]

Camp Manager:

Meet the Camp Manager, who is in charge of building up the Haven. He will give you quests to upgrade your Haven and resources to help you build the buildings. He might even help you with some other Haven QoL things later down the line[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/0e7cd1d975bc912828d56effae5cc4cf2e48f612.png"]

Garrik:

He is another updated NPC model that you already know and have interacted with in the Haven. This is the new Garrik, a mysterious old hunter who has a bit of a twist when you hear him talk to you. 🐺 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/cf298b7fd918624bc0b4477b112e6e52b55cb4d5.png"]

notes.title: Vaultbreakers: Weekly content update [June 6th 2025]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



This is where you can find our weekly updates in case you missed our posts on Discord and on X. Here is a summary of what was discussed this week and the week before. 🌿


PLAYTEST RESCHEDULED! 📆


Our upcoming playtest has been moved to July 3–9 to give us more time to polish the new content and ensure a smoother experience. We'll run another Stability Test in the coming weeks to make sure everything’s solid.

Plus… we’re cooking up a super exciting announcement! Stay tuned on our socials to hear more about what's to come! 🤩




NEW NPC 👩🏼‍⚕️

Meet Kira, a Nurse who can be found in the Outpost. She will be handling the infirmary, a new building that will be in the game soon! She will also be tied to some new quests! Do you think she is someone caring… or the opposite? 💉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/27931ea3788969b43141d1551ce69c2782bd8494.png"]


GRAPPLING HOOK?! 😈


Ever felt like you are too far away from your enemies and wish you had a way to get closer to them? Well, we have a solution to that! In the next playtest, you will be able to use this new activatable item called Harpoon, which allows you to pull yourself closer to other enemies. 🔥

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/013bb598dc5da72de672103a64d851a7080793e4.png"]

notes.title: April 10th Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
10-13 April Playtest 
PATCH NOTES: 
The main focus has been on improving the overall combat feel, implementing new dynamic elements and mechanics on the map, and to start implementing systems that give you goals and things to do in the game (other than just trying to survive!). We also further optimized the controller support and encourage anyone who can to play using controller. 
We have also added some long-awaited quality-of-life things and minor balance tweaks. 

🗺 Map changes

We have added the next of many *Happenings* on the map. These are events or enemies that players can interact with, but who each have an agenda of their own. 
 Look for Pitpaw in the southwest of the map, but beware!
 Dragon Vault portals are now not usable unless you have a Dragon Vault Crystal with you. You get these by completing a crafting quest chain. Check the new in-game challenges to learn more about it!
 There is only one queue to join now. Both solo players and duo players go into the same map.
 Added area names to the map.
Updated the encroaching circle to start later in the game, giving you more time to experience the *Happenings* and new content. To compromise, it will move slightly faster at the end of the game.


👹Enemy changes

 Many new named enemies traverse the map. These have stronger variations of existing abilities and have better loot. Some of them are part of quest chains and/or dynamic elements on the map.
 Enemies move around on the map.
   - Some will just patrol the immediate vicinity of where they spawn. Others will go on longer patrols either alone or in groups.
 Enemies now have randomized initial ability cooldowns.
 Clearer indicators on some of the bosses’ abilities.
 Clearer ground indicators for the Spiderlings.
 New regular enemy abilities.


🧝‍♀️Character changes
- Hearthguard
    - Major rework: We want to move in a direction where the accumulation of stacks and buffs on the characters is more rewarding and has a bigger payoff.
    - Check the Hearthguard’s abilities in-game for all the changes.
- Lightningcaller
    - Improved Lightningcaller’s basic attack casting VFX
    - Improved values, colors, and cast time of power vortex cast VFX.
    - Added a cast VFX to Zap Bang.
    - Changed the Ultra to be depending on the Energy you have when triggering it, and giving it a shorter cooldown.

💠 Misc
- We opened a South American server for this test due to a massive influx of testers from there.
- You can drop items on the ground by pressing X on your keyboard
- There are now 2 consumable slots available. You can use consumables by pressing the 1 and 2 keys on your keyboard
- New and improved icons for all items!
- Renamed the old “Shoulders” slot to “Trinkets” together with the new icons.
- Continuous performance optimization.
- Improved the UI for recipe books.
- You can now use the scroll button to zoom in or out from your character.

Bug fixes
- Fixed that indicators for skill shots didn’t always match projectile size.
- Fixed Imp Bolter projectile height
- Optimized all enemy colliders to indicate projectile impact more clearly.
- Fixed a bug where footstep audio would not work correctly inside the fog.
- Fixing Barrel Scrat’s attack animation timing.
- Fixed a missing outline for characters in smoke.
- Fixed the broken Named Item and enabled them in the dropables again.
- Fixed the wrong timing for the Elite Scrat Netters.

🤔Known issues
- Rock Muncher lacks audio
- The client will sometimes crash when you try to close it.
- Some enemies can get stuck when they leash and try to return to their starting point.
- One of the first challenges still calls for you to try and defeat a Swarmer even though most of the Swarmers have been replaced with Rock Munchers. There are events in the map that summon Swarmers though, so you are still able to complete the challenge.
- The Hearthguard can sometimes be slowed for a longer time by the oil. This usually resolves itself after a basic attack.
- Some small invisible colliders are on the map along the edges of passageways.
- The second consumable slot doesn’t have auto-equip from loot containers.
- Keybinding to right-click causes problems with interacting with items.

notes.title: Project F4E Monthly Update - October
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Welcome to our October Recap for Project F4E. Here is a summary of what has happened and shared during the month. 

Playtest:

The long wait for the next open playtest was finally over. The servers opened on October 5th for a 5-day playtest! 

During this playtest, we also set up challenges - Speedrun and Extraction. Leaderboard winners for the most extractions from each character won an Amazon gift card and the Vault VIP role. Winners from the Speedrun challenges also got the Vault VIP role.

The Vault VIP role allows a player to join exclusive smaller playtests. We’ll have other challenges and rewards in our next playtests too, so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/d31e9282a3d6dd8aeb23ed4883f92eb992fa4ded.png

Dwarf Talks:

As some of you have probably already seen from our social media platforms, we now have a YouTube series called Dwarf Talk, where interesting topics about Project F4E are discussed and shown in depth. If you want a certain topic to be discussed in this video series, don’t hesitate to ask in the comments or in our Discord server.

Head over to our YouTube channel to watch the series in our playlist.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/835719dfd4a34188a7bcdb12922249aa9770c80b.png

Art and Audio previews:

New audio and art updates to a game is something a lot of you guys like to see, so we have been more active with showing this off to our community. Every Wednesday, updated audio to our game is posted on our Discord server - for now, it has been an update to each character’s ability sound effects with a description of the changes. Updated artwork will start popping up on our social media and Discord server from next week. However, for Halloween, we had something special to show to the community!


Halloween:

The community was given a goal to reach on Twitter (now named X) to reveal one of our big Dragon Vault bosses! The goal was easily achieved, and we revealed the Corrupted Void Dragon, the inhabitant of the Dragon Vault. 

At first, the dragon looked mysterious in the shadows, waiting to reveal itself when the goal was met, and the community did it! Do you think you and your friends will be brave enough to face such a beast??

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/2382ca03e8363f0939af7b841771d53f4663e821.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/89434f0af054888e238b84523d15953e9ecfd4a6.png

notes.title: Project F4E Monthly Update - July 23
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Today starts our series of Monthly Update for our Project F4E. We’re sharing our weekly progress on Discord, and this is a summary of what we shared during the month. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to ask them in the comments.

1- Next Playtest: Late September

We don’t have an exact date yet, but the next Playtest will be around late September. Most of the following content will be playable during this next test! 

2- Weapon Variation

During a mission or in the shop, you can find different weapons for your class. Each of them will change your basic attacks. In the video below, you can see the variations for the Ranger, with the Longbow, Short bow, Quick bow and Hunting bow.

[previewyoutube=cC3cCrcuOZU;full][/previewyoutube]

3- Stats update 

We’re also using this opportunity to fully update how stats work in Project F4E. Our goal with this is to give you more paths to explore with your characters and have more fun creating builds. 

More information on this will come 🙂

4- New Character: The Assassin 

We're super excited about this mysterious addition to the game! The team had a blast creating its design. (some of it is still WIP)
While I can't spill all the details just yet, rest assured that the Assassin will be a force to be reckoned with. Stay tuned for a full overview of their abilities and powers! 
The Assassin won’t be ready for our next Playtest, but we hope to have a first version ready for the next one. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/a27a75b5695a1922b3611a20cf44f2b1870cb45f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/79bc367c33c04751058d83cd1f72b58f510a581c.png

5- A new Level: The Dragon Vault

When on a regular mission. You can find either normal portals that bring you back to your base, or another kind of portal that brings you directly into a vault where Ancient Dragons lived ages ago… 
Inside this vault, you’ll find powerful enemies as well as bosses that have nothing to do with the monsters you encountered before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/1b35baf695d34af4d2735eab9ccffdf33ead90a6.png


These bosses guard epic rewards and powerful artefacts, but will you be able to defeat them? You won't be the only one coveting their treasures, so be ready for any unexpected twists and turns!
Our team is currently building this epic level, and we are very excited for you to visit it. You’ll be able to play an early version of it (with some placeholders) in our upcoming Playtest.

That's all for today!

That’s a lot of big new content for this month! We’re still working on some very cool features for this test, including an emote wheel and a mysterious other BIG feature. 

Follow us on our other social media to not miss anything. We’re also dropping keys there: 

Twitter: https://twitter.com/BetaDwarf 
Discord:  https://discord.gg/projectf4e
